add.title: AI page (/framework/ai/): use the width at 1920 and 3440
add.why: worktree-watch flags it on every save in any worktree: empty share 0.71 at 1920 and 0.75 at 3440 (over 0.6), e.g. .worktree-logs/qf-4/shots/framework-ai-1920.png, 2026-10-24. Measured on worktrees, which lack the generated data, so check the live page first.

complete.outcome: No change needed on this page. The live page (2026-10-24 02:35, headless) fills the width at 1920: the date column, the tab row and two session columns span the main area; the empty share is below the list, because few sessions exist early in the day (worktrees lack the generated data, so they read even emptier). At 3440 the content caps at about 2,000 px with three columns and type at its 1920 size; that is the sitewide type and spacing scale at 3440, the layout work mastermind-page owns, not this page.
complete.caveats: A busy afternoon fills the lists; judge the vertical space then, not at 02:35.
